items.claim: Replica-lag NotFound makes the lister ZREM a live index member for good
items.consequence: With redis_cluster2 and useReadOnly or routeByLatency, the value key and the index key live in different slots, so GET, EXISTS and ZRANGEBYLEX can hit different, differently lagged replicas. A just-created entry whose index member has replicated but whose value has not makes FindEntry return ErrNotFound; the master ZREM removes the member, and the EXISTS recheck goes to the same lagging replica, sees 0, and does not restore it. UpdateEntry never re-adds the member, so the live entry stays out of listings and DeleteFolderChildren until the same path is inserted again. Before this change the same lag only produced a transient skip. The PR claims the compensation behaves identically on all three transports, which does not hold for replica reads.
items.proposed_fix: Do not prune on a read that may have come from a replica: skip removeOrphanedDirectoryListMember when RedisCluster2Store was initialized with readOnly or routeByLatency (keep a flag on UniversalRedis2Store), or confirm absence against the master before ZREM. Assumption: only the cluster store exposes replica reads; the sentinel store uses a master-only failover client.

native_payload.intent: redis2 ListDirectoryEntries left per-directory ZSET index members whose value key was gone (Redis TTL expiry, eviction, out-of-band DEL), so the index grew without bound. The change ZREMs the member in the not-found branch, then re-checks the value key with EXISTS and re-adds the member with ZAddNX if the value reappeared or the check failed, to survive a concurrent InsertEntry. Adds opt-in live-Redis tests.

actionable_findings.title: Replica-lag NotFound makes the lister ZREM a live index member for good
actionable_findings.suggested_fix: Do not prune on a read that may have come from a replica: skip removeOrphanedDirectoryListMember when RedisCluster2Store was initialized with readOnly or routeByLatency (keep a flag on UniversalRedis2Store), or confirm absence against the master before ZREM. residual_risks: A concurrent DeleteEntry can interleave ZREM, InsertEntry SET, EXISTS=1, DeleteEntry (DEL value, ZREM no-op), then the restore ZAddNX, which re-creates an orphan member. It is bounded and pruned by the next listing, so convergence is eventual, not immediate (universal_redis_store.go:250).
The ZAddNX result in the restore is discarded, so a transient failure after ZREM can leave a live entry out of the index; UpdateEntry does not re-add it (universal_redis_store.go:250).

Pruning the member of a directory entry whose own value key is gone leaves its child index key '<path>\x00' and descendants unreachable; the old lingering member let a later DeleteFolderChildren on the parent DEL that key. Only reachable if a directory's value key is lost while its children remain.
testing_gaps: TestRemoveOrphanedDirectoryListMemberKeepsRecreatedEntry calls the helper sequentially and only with an empty keyPrefix; the EXISTS-error restore branch and the prefixed restore are not exercised.

All live-Redis tests use a standalone client; nothing covers redis_cluster2 with replica reads. The tests skip unless RUN_REDIS_TESTS=1, and no Redis server was available in this review, so none of them ran here.
